nodes.label: Misinformation provokes more moral outrage than trusted sources
nodes.norm_label: misinformation provokes more moral outrage than trusted sources
nodes.rationale: The 2024 Science finding the chapter must preserve, including sharing without reading, quoted from the full read the session performed. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-dawnbook/2026-09-27 - trim-ch06-to-7kb [ses_f1bbd65edffev3efbsZwRRdD6P].md:L771] "Penelitian terbaru menemukan **misinformasi cenderung memancing lebih banyak kemarahan moral dibanding sumber tepercaya** (McLoughlin, Brady, dkk., 2024, terbit di *Science*).
